beats.action_visual: Su Nian wipes the coffee shop counter with a rag, glancing at the entrance for the third time. An old man dozes by the window, a girl frowns at her laptop in the corner.
A man in a grey suit walks in through the door, the doorbell chimes. He sits at the counter without looking at the menu, pulls out his phone and places it face-down on the table.
Su Nian nods, turns around and grinds coffee beans. The man taps his fingers on the counter in a rhythmic pattern — index, middle, ring, repeating. His suit cuff has a small ink stain.
Su Nian places the americano in front of the man. He takes a sip, sets the cup down. A clean arc-shaped mark appears on the rim — condensation, not lipstick.
Su Nian turns to wipe a second table. She pauses, noticing the man's cup is still steaming but he has already set it down.
Su Nian walks back to the counter, picks up the americano. The cup is hot to the touch. She closes her eyes and takes a sip.
All ambient sounds fade to silence — the old man's snoring, the girl's keyboard, street horns all vanish. A low voice emerges, muffled as if through a wall.
beats.inner_voice: This month's KPI is impossible again. Old Chen says if I don't close the deal, I'm out. That shop... the contract is ready...

beats.action_visual: Su Nian's eyes snap open. All ambient sounds return instantly — the old man shifts in his sleep, the girl's keyboard clacks.
Su Nian looks down at her left hand. The old burn scar on her ring finger is still there. Beside it, a faint new mark she doesn't recognize.
The man in the grey suit stands up, typing on his phone without looking up.
Su Nian answers. The man scans a QR code to pay, then turns and walks out of the coffee shop without looking back.
Su Nian watches the man walk into the revolving door of the office building across the street, disappearing behind the glass curtain wall.
Su Nian looks down at the americano cup. On the rim, a faint lipstick mark — not hers, she hasn't worn lipstick today.
Su Nian places the cup in the sink, turns on the hot water faucet. The stream rinses away the lipstick mark, the condensation, everything.
beats.inner_voice: That shop... the contract is ready...

beats.action_visual: Su Nian dries her hands, looks down at her left ring finger. The scar remains. But something feels different — something is missing.
